metrics.O: Officially labelled rows only, classes reweighted to the target scored prevalence
metrics.M: Mixture of the real-label official stratum (mass phi) and the pseudo-negative stratum
metrics.note: l4_rank_mean is the OOF analogue of the deployed October 3 payload: the equal percentile-rank mean of legacy_sep15_refit and pool_lgbm inside each held fold

config.phi_identification: 0.0706 = phi * p_strong + (1 - phi) * p_weak, with p_weak from the three-enzyme weak-primary bound
config.status: Validation-design probe; nothing fitted, no candidate, submission or upload

caveats: Metric O conditions on the strong-primary region, so it cannot reward correct down-ranking of weak-primary rows and understates the pool model
Metric M assumes the blind scored set is a two-stratum mixture and that each stratum is sampled by its development counterpart
phi is identified from the published prevalence, which is itself a reconstruction
Scores are frozen from one run; nothing is refitted here
The L4 analogue is rebuilt from two frozen OOF columns, not refitted
